title: Section coherence of normalized ordered Tate pullback
statement: Let A be a commutative ring with N=0 in A and let t be normalized ordinary finite Tate transport [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. Let p:Z→X and s:X→Z satisfy s≫p=id_X, and assume N is invertible on X and Z. For every d≥0 use the ordered shifted coefficient L_T(d) and its pullback comparison c_f:Lf*L_target(d)≅L_source(d) of [def-amb-vector-integration]. Then c_s^{-1} followed by Ls*(c_p^{-1}) followed by the canonical section pullback compositor equals id_{L_X(d)}. This involves only coefficient pullbacks and no trace or exceptional inverse image.

source.place: Agreement on the model: integration transpose, diagonal restriction and normalized standard-pair DNC

proof.text: Apply the already proved private coefficient_comp calculation in OrderedTateExactOpenComposition, accessed by a proof-only import all to two identity morphisms. Cancel the coefficient comparison, and use the left unit law for the derived pullback compositor and naturality of leftDerivedUpperStarId. Since the coefficient comparison is invertible, this forces its identity-morphism component to equal leftDerivedUpperStarId on the ordered Tate coefficient. This is identity_comparison and coefficient_identity in the Lean proof.

Apply the same composition theorem to s, p and the composite named identity via hs.symm. Substitute the identity component just proved. Expand the canonical section compositor as the inverse of the named composition comparison followed by leftDerivedUpperStarId. Cancel the compositor with its inverse, combine mapped inverse/hom coefficient comparisons using functoriality, and cancel the remaining section coefficient comparison. The result is the identity, without induction or additional coherence obligations.

proof_origin.place: S6: access the complete private arbitrary-composition lemma coefficient_comp in OrderedTateExactOpenComposition by import all, derive its identity component from invertibility and the derived unit law, then cancel the section compositor.

lean.statement:
theorem orderedTateSectionPullback (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (p : Z ⟶ X) (s : X ⟶ Z) (hs : s ≫ p = 𝟙 X)
    (hX : IsUnit (N : Γ(X, ⊤))) (hZ : IsUnit (N : Γ(Z, ⊤))) (d : ℕ) :
    (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA t s hZ d).inv ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A s).map
        (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA t p hX d).inv ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarCompSectionIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) s p hs).hom.app
        (affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA X d) = 𝟙 _
